registration.errors: record verbatim; never treat rejected registration as a dependency bug

layout: fresh isolated stage; explicit ancestor dimensions; each pair is siblings in identical ancestry; targets absolutely positioned so their intrinsic widths do not determine container dimensions; clip stage overflow without transforming or zooming it
query_order: every ancestor outer-to-inner: specified cssText; computed zoom,width,height,inline-size,block-size,container-type,writing-mode; client/offset dimensions; bounding rect
targets in declared variant order: specified cssText; custom value (registered variants only), computed width,height,zoom,font-size,line-height,writing-mode; client/offset dimensions; bounding rect
rounding: keep CSSOM strings and raw numeric DOMRect values; do not infer equality from rounded offset/client values
settle: after style construction or mutation, two animation frames then measurements; record the phase, no performance timing verdict
alternate_query_order: optional second fresh DOM pass in reversed target order, preserving and labeling both raw results
pass_gate: only completeness/setup validation; no cross-zoom cqw expected numeric values
reported_comparisons: raw paired ordinary/registered values and deltas only; no automatic spec violation or acceptance classification
